design.note: Instability test of 2026-11-01: the runs of 2026-10-28, frames 2e-3 s apart in both classes (set A), and the 2026-10-28 triples drawn again without times (set B0). central-dt3e-5 and central-dt4e-5 are too short for a 4e-3 s triple and are in set B0 only (in_eq_set false).

path_prefixes: frames/ and requests/ are in this test set, docs/ is the repository

label_rule.note: as on 2026-10-28: a run crashed when its log has a floating point exception trace and no 'End'; its triples ending 1 to unstable_within_steps steps before the crash are scored 'unstable', earlier ones are not scored; runs that ended give 'stable' triples

instability-eq2ms-notime.note: SHA-256 over the system prompt and every text part, joined by U+001F; one variant means every item of the set sends the same text

instability-eq2ms-reltime.note: SHA-256 over the system prompt and every text part, joined by U+001F; one variant means every item of the set sends the same text

instability-oct28-notime.note: SHA-256 over the system prompt and every text part, joined by U+001F; one variant means every item of the set sends the same text

pictures: no step and no time in the titles or the PNG metadata (show_time=False)
note: Each state is drawn once (frames/<run>/<time>/) and used by every triple of every set that has it. The runner replaces only the model name.
